entities.summary: Nudnida "Chun" Luangnam is a former tennis player from Thailand. She has career-high WTA rankings of 195 in singles, set on 13 May 2013, and 342 in doubles, achieved on 13 November 2017. Nudnida Luangnam was a athletes & competitors from Sukhothai Thani (b. 1987-02-27, Sukhothai Thani). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
